title: Skill input brief — single-modern-slot-creator v1.0.0
description: Structured brief accepted by the single-modern-slot-creator skill. Every section and every field is optional: a missing field or the sentinel string "AUTO" delegates the decision to the skill, which must record its choice in docs/assumption-log.md. An empty object {} is a valid brief. Cross-field incompatibilities (e.g. UK real-money vs bonus buy) are enforced by the allOf conditionals at the root.

project.description: Project identity, release intent, and market targeting.

gameName.description: Public display name of the game, or "AUTO" to let the skill invent an original name (never a trademarked or existing game name).

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case directory slug for games/<slug>/, or "AUTO" to derive one from the game name.

releaseLevel.description: Intended maturity of the deliverable. The skill always produces certification-ready candidates, never certified builds.

targetJurisdictions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2/alpha-3 style jurisdiction codes (e.g. "MT", "GB", "UK", "SE", "ON"). Empty array means jurisdiction-agnostic with most-restrictive defaults applied at runtime via jurisdiction-policies.json. Listing UK/GB for real money (demoOnly not true) forbids bonusBuyRequested and autoplayRequested (UKGC policy).

targetLanguages.description: BCP-47 style language tags the client UI must support.

items.description: Lowercase language code with optional region, e.g. "en", "pt-BR".

targetCurrencies.description: ISO 4217 currency codes. All money is handled in integer minor units of these currencies.

demoOnly.description: true = fun-play/demo build only, never wired to real money. Relaxes the UK bonus-buy/autoplay incompatibility because no real-money UKGC rules apply.

theme.description: Core theme (e.g. "deep-sea vents", "clockwork carnival") or "AUTO" for an original research-driven theme. Must be original and adult-appropriate; never a copy of an existing game's theme.

narrative.description: Optional story/fantasy framing the presentation should express, or "AUTO".

mood.description: Emotional register of art, motion and audio, or "AUTO".

visualStyle.description: Art style directive (e.g. "painterly realism", "stylized low-poly") or "AUTO".

artDimensionality.description: Rendering look of the art package. "2.5D" = 2D sprites with parallax depth layers.

charactersAllowed.description: Whether original characters may appear in art and animation.

themeRestrictions.description: Hard exclusions for theme/art content (e.g. "no gore", "no religious iconography").

items.description: One exclusion rule in plain language.

layout.description: Grid geometry and orientation priorities. If variableGrid is true, rowsPerReel is required and overrides rows.

primarySlotType.description: Win-evaluation archetype, or "AUTO" to let the concept step decide.

rows.description: Visible rows when the grid is uniform, or "AUTO". Ignored when variableGrid is true (rowsPerReel wins).

variableGrid.description: true = per-reel row counts (rowsPerReel becomes required). false = uniform rows.

rowsPerReel.description: Visible rows for each reel, left to right. Required when variableGrid is true; array length must match the reel count.

orientationPriority.description: Primary layout target; all other layouts are still specified per the UI gate.

math.description: Math-model targets. All money values are integer minor units; RTP values are fractions. minimumBetMinor must not exceed maximumBetMinor (checked by the skill during normalization).

targetRtp.description: Primary RTP target as a fraction (0.80–0.99), or "AUTO" (defaults to 0.9600).

alternativeRtpProfiles.description: Optional lower/market-specific RTP profiles (e.g. [0.94, 0.92]) to be built alongside the primary target.

maximumWinXBet.description: Hard max-win cap as a multiple of total bet (100–250000), or "AUTO" (defaults to 10000). Enforced in math and engine via a max_win_termination step.

minimumBetMinor.description: Smallest total bet in integer minor units (e.g. 10 = €0.10).

maximumBetMinor.description: Largest total bet in integer minor units (e.g. 10000 = €100.00). Must be >= minimumBetMinor.

targetHitFrequency.description: Desired fraction of rounds with any win (0.05–0.60), or "AUTO" (~0.25–0.33 default band).

targetFeatureFrequency.description: Desired natural trigger rate of the base `feature` tier expressed as N in "1 in N" spins (20–2000), or "AUTO" (~1/150–1/250 default band).

mechanics.description: Mechanic selection. "AUTO" values are decided at the mechanics step; at most 1 primary + 3 supporting mechanics survive the gate. Never use trademarked mechanic names.

primaryMechanic.description: Requested primary mechanic in kebab-case (e.g. "cascading-wins", "hold-and-respin"), or "AUTO".

secondaryMechanics.description: Requested supporting mechanics in kebab-case; at most 3 are kept.

cascades.description: Whether winning symbols are removed and refilled (cascades/tumbles), or "AUTO".

wildTypes.description: Wild behaviours to include. Empty array = let the mechanics step decide.

multipliers.description: Whether win multipliers are part of the design, or "AUTO".

expandingGrid.description: Whether the grid can grow during play (extra rows/reels), or "AUTO".

holdAndRespin.description: Whether a hold-and-respin (lock cash symbols, respin counter) mode is included, or "AUTO".

persistentProgression.description: Whether in-feature persistent collection/progression is included (never across real-money rounds in a player-adaptive way), or "AUTO".

jackpot.description: Whether fixed (non-progressive) jackpot awards (JP_MINI..JP_GRAND) are included.

scatterFeatureHierarchy.description: The mandatory three-tier scatter bonus hierarchy: 3 scatters → feature, 4 → super_feature, 5+ → ultimate_feature. Tiers must be materially different in math AND presentation. Scatter counts must be strictly increasing across tiers (skill-verified).

enabled.description: Whether the scatter feature hierarchy is active. Disabling it forbids bonusBuyRequested (there is no feature to buy into).

featureBonusScatters.description: Scatter count that triggers the `feature` tier.

superFeatureScatters.description: Scatter count that triggers the `super_feature` tier. Must exceed featureBonusScatters.

ultimateFeatureScatters.description: Scatter count (this many or more) that triggers the `ultimate_feature` tier. Must exceed superFeatureScatters.

countingRule.description: Which grid states count scatters toward a trigger.

countCascadedScatters.description: Whether scatters landing in cascade refills count toward triggers/retriggers.

retriggerAllowed.description: Whether features can retrigger (always with a hard cap in the math model).

optionalModes.description: Optional play modes. All are jurisdiction-gated at runtime via jurisdiction-policies.json; requesting one here only asks for it to be built. Presentation modes never alter outcomes.

bonusBuyRequested.description: Build bonus-buy (feature purchase) modes. Incompatible with real-money UK/GB targeting (UKGC prohibits feature buy); allowed if project.demoOnly is true. Requires scatterFeatureHierarchy.enabled.

enhancedChanceRequested.description: Build an enhanced-chance (ante bet) mode that raises feature trigger odds for a higher bet.

animationSkip.description: Allow tapping to skip win/feature presentation (never changes results).

autoplayRequested.description: Build autoplay with full stop conditions. Incompatible with real-money UK/GB targeting (UKGC prohibits autoplay); allowed if project.demoOnly is true.

presentation.description: Immersion and performance targets for the PixiJS client. Reduced-motion and low-performance variants are mandatory regardless of these flags.

fullyImmersive.description: Full-scene themed environment rather than a flat reel frame.

reactiveEnvironment.description: Environment reacts to game events (wins, anticipation, features).

particles.description: Particle systems for wins, trails and ambience.

shaderEffects.description: Custom shader effects (glow, distortion, colour grading).

adaptiveAudio.description: Layered music that adapts to game state (music.base/feature/super_feature/ultimate_feature).

targetFps.description: Frame-rate target on the primary device class.

reducedMotion.description: Ship the reduced-motion variant set (mandatory; false is recorded as a risk and overridden).

lowPerformanceMode.description: Ship the low-performance fallback profile (mandatory; false is recorded as a risk and overridden).

technical.description: Engine and integration requirements. Real-money outcomes always come from the server; the dev round provider is dev/test only.

renderer.description: Rendering stack. "AUTO" resolves to pixijs-v8; "threejs" requires explicit justification in the decision log.

serverAuthoritative.description: Server-authoritative outcomes. Must be true; false fails validation of the brief at normalization (non-negotiable design rule).

developmentRoundProvider.description: Include the seeded, clearly dev-only local round provider.

productionRgsAdapter.description: Include the typed RGS adapter interface for later real-money integration.

webgl2Required.description: WebGL2 is the baseline rendering context.

deliverables.description: Which artifact groups to produce. Everything defaults to true; disabling a deliverable is recorded in the assumption log.

simulationSuite.description: uv-managed Python simulation package and reports.

artPrompts.description: prompts/art-prompts.json (and generated art when tools are available).

allOf.$comment: Incompatibility: real-money UK/GB targeting forbids bonus buy and autoplay (UKGC). Validation message: 'optionalModes.bonusBuyRequested and optionalModes.autoplayRequested must be false (or omitted) when project.targetJurisdictions includes UK/GB and project.demoOnly is not true.'

bonusBuyRequested.description: Bonus buy is prohibited for real-money UK/GB play (UKGC). Set project.demoOnly to true or remove UK/GB from targetJurisdictions to request bonus buy.

autoplayRequested.description: Autoplay is prohibited for real-money UK/GB play (UKGC). Set project.demoOnly to true or remove UK/GB from targetJurisdictions to request autoplay.

allOf.$comment: Conditional requirement: variableGrid true requires rowsPerReel. Validation message: 'layout.rowsPerReel is required when layout.variableGrid is true.'
Incompatibility: bonus buy needs a feature to buy into. Validation message: 'optionalModes.bonusBuyRequested must be false (or omitted) when scatterFeatureHierarchy.enabled is false.'

bonusBuyRequested.description: Bonus buy requires the scatter feature hierarchy to be enabled.

auto.description: Sentinel: delegate this decision to the skill; the chosen value is logged in docs/assumption-log.md.

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
